title: UTC calendar date
spec: Implement utc_day(timestamp). timestamp is an ISO 8601 datetime string with an explicit numeric UTC offset, accepted by datetime.fromisoformat. Return the UTC calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD, not the date in the input offset. Naive datetimes are outside the contract.
target_defect: The function extracts the local-offset date before converting to UTC.
author_rationale: The change uses the standard datetime parser and ISO date formatting.
limitations: Small synthetic function; not a natural pull request. Correct means conforming to the stated contract and supplied checks, not universally bug-free.
